question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Over the trailing four quarters operating cash flow is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.value} against a net loss of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income.value}, so operating cash flow over net income prints {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income.value} and accruals over average assets {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets.value}, the most negative reading in the company's history after fiscal 2025's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}; the earlier years ran {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}. The gap is non-cash: the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025 carried net income of {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.2} against operating cash flow of {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.2}, and the release's covenant table adds impairment charges back as a non-cash item. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.value}, above one, so income swings more than cash rather than less; the fourth quarter of fiscal 2024 was also a loss, {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.6}. In the quarter itself cash conversion is strong: operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value} against net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter.value}, with cash flow up {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.value|pct} year over year against income up {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.value|pct}; six-month operating cash flow is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.this_year_to_date.value} against net income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income.parts.this_year_to_date.value}. Working capital: year over year receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change.value}, inventory {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change.value} and payables {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change.value}; the cash-flow statement shows receivables absorbing {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change.value}, inventory absorbing {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.cash_flow_statement_change.value} and payables supplying {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change.value}, so the payables build broadly offsets the receivable and inventory build and the net working-capital effect on trailing cash flow is small. In the six months the payables line swung from {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_payables.parts.prior_year_to_date.value} a year earlier to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_payables.parts.this_year_to_date.value} while the inventory line swung from {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.prior_year_to_date.value} to {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.this_year_to_date.value}; management's text names only higher cash earnings. Articulation gaps between balance-sheet and cash-flow changes are {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap.value} for receivables, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap.value} for inventory and {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.articulation_gap.value} for payables, all positive; the Basler allocation brought receivables of {note_tables.tables.notes_37.facts.1.value}, inventory of {note_tables.tables.notes_37.facts.2.value} and current liabilities of {note_tables.tables.notes_37.facts.8.value} onto the balance sheet outside operating cash flow, which with currency translation is of the size of the gaps, so the statements articulate once the acquisition is allowed for. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value} is treated as a real cost and is already removed from quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.value}.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Earnings understate cash because of non-cash impairments; in-quarter cash conversion is strong and working capital articulates once the Basler balances are allowed for, so cash quality is sound while trailing GAAP earnings are not a usable base.

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables are not outrunning revenue in the quarter: days sales outstanding on quarter-end balances is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value}, the lowest of the six filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} a year earlier and a peak of {trend_table.quarters-back-3.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} in the third quarter of fiscal 2025, and receivables over quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue.value}, also the lowest; the trailing average-balance measure is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding.value}. The fiscal 2025 year-end reading of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} was the highest of five years, up from {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.days_sales_outstanding.value} two years earlier, so the year-end stretch has reversed rather than extended. Revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year.value|pct} in the quarter and {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters.value|pct} over four quarters, with part of the growth acquired. Contract liabilities move against revenue: deferred revenue fell from {note_tables.tables.notes_79.facts.13.value} at fiscal year-end to {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities.value}, a change of {note_tables.tables.notes_79.changes.6.value}, while the cash-flow statement's contract-liability line prints a smaller decrease; the balance is still above the {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities.value} of a year earlier, and over quarterly revenue it is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue.value}, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue.value}. The year-end spike coincided with the Basler closing, so the likeliest reading is acquired customer deposits unwinding into revenue, but no text explains it. Other customer reserves also fell, by {note_tables.tables.notes_79.changes.7.value}, while sales through distribution grew. The notes reader found no change to revenue-policy wording and no new judgement area such as variable consideration or principal-versus-agent; sales to the related party Powersem were {note_tables.tables.notes_213.facts.0.value} in the quarter, immaterial. Fourth-quarter concentration cannot be tested because no fourth quarter is a stated duration in the record, and no extended payment terms or bill-and-hold arrangements appear in any item.
revenue_recognition.verdict: Clean on the measures available: receivables sit at a six-quarter low relative to revenue; the adverse movements are small, unexplained declines in contract liabilities and customer reserves.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The allowance against receivables rose in dollars to {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance.value} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance.value} a year earlier, but its ratio to gross receivables is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value}, the second lowest of six quarters and below the {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value} of two years earlier; the fiscal 2025 year-end ratio of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value} was the lowest of five years against {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value} two years before, and the notes reader could not tell whether the new credit-loss practical expedient changed the method. Inventory valuation reserves fell by {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.3.value} since year-end while net inventory rose by {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.4.value}, taking the reserve ratio to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio.value} from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio.value} in the prior quarter and a peak of {trend_table.quarters-back-3.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio.value}; the inventory table offers no explanation, and the numbers cannot tell a release from write-offs of reserved stock at the closing sites, so no adjustment is entered. The fixed-asset impairment of {note_tables.tables.notes_82.facts.27.value}, of which {note_tables.tables.notes_82.facts.24.value} in Electronics, was measured with unobservable inputs the note does not describe; net property fell {note_tables.tables.notes_63.changes.4.value} since year-end. Measurement-period adjustments raised Basler goodwill by {note_tables.tables.notes_67.facts.15.value} while cutting acquired intangibles, inventories, receivables and property, which shifts value into a non-amortising asset and lowers future charges; total goodwill still fell {note_tables.tables.notes_67.changes.11.value} on translation of {note_tables.tables.notes_67.facts.19.value}. Electronics goodwill stands at {note_tables.tables.notes_67.facts.28.value} after accumulated impairment of {note_tables.tables.notes_67.facts.24.value}, and the semiconductor business inside it is closing two sites, yet no item describes an interim goodwill test or headroom. The quarterly effective tax rate fell on statute-of-limitation lapses and excess share-based compensation benefits, both discrete; the release treats the statute benefit as a non-GAAP item and pairs it with an indemnification-receivable reversal in other income, so the two offset. Over the trailing four quarters tax expense of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.value} exceeds pre-tax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income.value}, an effective rate of {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}, because the fiscal 2025 impairment was not deductible. Management attributes higher selling, general and administrative expense to higher annual incentive accruals, yet accrued employee liabilities fell by {note_tables.tables.notes_79.changes.0.value} since year-end, which the text does not reconcile. A pension settlement charge is deferred to the first quarter of fiscal 2027; the restructuring reserve fell by {note_tables.tables.notes_79.changes.5.value} while quarterly restructuring charges rose to {note_tables.tables.notes_82.facts.19.value} from {note_tables.tables.notes_83.facts.19.value}; the Polytronics sale states proceeds but no gain or loss. Warranty reserves are not tagged in any period and the customer fuse recall remains unaccrued and unquantified.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: Moderate discretion: two reserve ratios are thinning, the impairment rests on undisclosed inputs, the purchase allocation keeps moving value into goodwill and the quarter's tax rate was lowered by discrete items; none is large against earnings, but the direction of estimate changes mostly favours reported income.

cost_deferral.finding: No capitalised development cost is tagged in any period, so research and development of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.value} over four quarters appears to be expensed in full; the record cannot confirm a zero. Soft assets are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share.value} of total assets, down from the six-quarter high of {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share.value} in the prior quarter but above the {trend_table.quarters-back-3.ratios.soft_asset_share.value} of the third quarter of fiscal 2025, carried by goodwill of {note_tables.tables.notes_67.facts.31.value} and intangibles of {note_tables.tables.notes_70.facts.14.value}. Items the release excludes as special recur: restructuring charges were {note_tables.tables.notes_82.facts.23.value} for six months against {note_tables.tables.notes_83.facts.23.value} a year earlier and {note_tables.tables.notes_82.facts.19.value} in the quarter against {note_tables.tables.notes_83.facts.19.value}; restructuring, impairment and other charges together were {note_tables.tables.notes_82.facts.39.value} against {note_tables.tables.notes_83.facts.39.value}, and the restructuring note implies further exit charges as the announced closures proceed. The numbers reader records that the per-share effect of non-GAAP adjustments widened against a year earlier; the calculator holds no non-GAAP gap because no taxonomy concept carries the adjusted measure. Six-month capital spending of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.this_year_to_date.value} ran below six-month depreciation of {note_tables.tables.notes_187.facts.14.value}, and trailing capital spending of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.value} is below the {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure.value} of a year earlier, so free cash flow is not lifted by deferral of costs into assets but is flattered by spending below the asset base's consumption. Deferred financing costs rose by {note_tables.tables.notes_91.changes.7.value} with the amended credit agreement, a normal capitalisation.
cost_deferral.verdict: No cost deferral found; the earnings-quality issue runs the other way, with recurring charges labelled special that widen the adjusted-to-reported gap, and capital spending below depreciation.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Receivables factoring, supplier-finance obligations, unconditional purchase obligations and guarantee exposure are tagged in no period, and the notes repeat that there are no off-balance-sheet arrangements; the operating lease liability is stated only at fiscal year-end, {ratios.solvency.operating_lease_liability.value}, with a current portion of {note_tables.tables.notes_79.facts.2.value}. Payables supplied {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change.value} of trailing operating cash flow and the balance rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change.value} year over year to days payable of {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding.value}; set against receivables absorbing {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change.value} and inventory absorbing {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.cash_flow_statement_change.value}, the working-capital contribution nets close to nothing, so the payables build reads as funding the inventory build rather than as engineering, and no adjustment is entered. No classification shift between operating and investing is visible: proceeds from the Polytronics equity investment and from a Basler asset held for sale sit in investing, and stock-award proceeds sit in financing. The cash conversion cycle is {ratios.efficiency.cash_conversion_cycle.value} days. Share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.value}, up from {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.share_based_compensation} for fiscal 2025, and acquisition spending of {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions.value} are already removed from quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.value} against simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple.value}. Two covenant matters sit outside the statements: the release says the credit agreement was amended to add restructuring and business-optimisation expenses back to covenant EBITDA, which the quarterly report does not mention, and the release's net debt is far above the balance-sheet net debt of {ratios.solvency.net_debt.value} computed from total debt of {ratios.solvency.total_debt.value} and cash of {terms.cash_and_short_term_investments_now.value}, so the release's leverage figures rest on a covenant definition rather than on the balance sheet. No variable-interest entity is described; the three equity-method investees appear only in the related-party table.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: No cash-flow engineering found in the statements themselves; the covenant measures in the release diverge from GAAP and the quarterly report is silent on the definition change.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: The controls section states disclosure controls were effective and no internal-control change occurred; no material weakness, auditor change or finance-officer departure is reported this quarter, and the auditor's report and critical audit matters belong to the 10-K, not this 10-Q. Fiscal year-end balances refiled in this report are unchanged from the 10-K for every line the numbers reader read, so no quiet restatement is traced. Several small filing-quality signals remain. The filing tags two different values of interest paid for the same six-month period, which is why the calculator could not compute trailing interest paid. The debt note now says the issuance costs of the credit agreement completed on 2026-03-12 were incurred during the three and six months ended 2026-06-27, where the prior quarter dated them to the first quarter, and the effective-rate sentence changed from the hedged portion to with the hedge. The segment and property notes call the two semiconductor site closures announced, yet the index of current reports shows no exit-cost or material-impairment item and the release does not mention the sites. Historical signals from the numbers reader's unquotable list: a notification of late filing for the fiscal 2024 annual report on 2025-02-27, and a current report of 2023-08-16 carrying only a change of certifying accountant. Related-party purchases from the equity investee ATEC rose by {note_tables.tables.notes_213.changes.10.value} in the quarter and {note_tables.tables.notes_213.changes.11.value} over six months, to {note_tables.tables.notes_213.facts.20.value}; subsidiary-list changes and comment letters are not in the input.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: No control failure or restatement found; a handful of internal inconsistencies in the debt note and in the filing's own tagging, and an announced closure without a current report, are disclosure-quality blemishes rather than evidence of misstatement.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: Every notes item carrying a direction is scored in the reconciliation list. The numbers confirm most: the site impairment and the fall in net property, the Basler goodwill increase, the end of the inventory step-up charge, higher selling costs, the lower quarterly tax rate, the fall in other income, the foreign-exchange swing, the gross-margin gain, the sales and segment-income movements in Electronics, Transportation and Industrial, the automotive-sensor decline and the operating-cash-flow increase. Two contradict. The release attributes passenger-vehicle weakness to lower global car builds, yet passenger-car products revenue rose to {note_tables.tables.notes_9.facts.27.value} from {note_tables.tables.notes_10.facts.27.value} in the quarter and to {note_tables.tables.notes_9.facts.31.value} from {note_tables.tables.notes_10.facts.31.value} over six months; only automotive sensors fell, to {note_tables.tables.notes_9.facts.35.value} from {note_tables.tables.notes_10.facts.35.value}, which the quarterly report ascribes to a chosen exit. And the Industrial item is set to a decline in segment operating income, which in fact rose by {note_tables.tables.notes_182.changes.20.value} to {note_tables.tables.notes_182.facts.40.value}; the margin decline the text describes is consistent with revenue rising {note_tables.tables.notes_182.changes.4.value} and amortisation {note_tables.tables.notes_187.changes.12.value}, but the direction recorded on the account is contradicted. Items on next-quarter guidance and bookings, the dividend raised after quarter-end, the fiscal 2027 pension charge, covenant EBITDA, the Basler asset held for sale, the Polytronics balance, the acquired-balance write-downs and Europe volumes are unresolved because the calculator holds no field for them. Release against 10-Q: quarterly net sales of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter.value} and derived quarterly operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value} agree with the release's headline figures, and operating cash flow grew {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.value|pct}, in line with the release's free-cash-flow growth. The documents differ in narrative: the release dates the statute-lapse tax benefit to the first quarter while the tax note cites it for both periods; the release describes a covenant add-back the 10-Q omits; the release's net debt is a covenant figure far above the balance-sheet {ratios.solvency.net_debt.value}; and the release never mentions the site closures the 10-Q calls announced.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: Release and 10-Q agree on the headline figures; the narrative diverges on passenger-vehicle causes, tax-benefit timing, covenant definitions and the site closures, and one recorded direction is contradicted by the segment table.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: turnover is improving, with days of inventory at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}, the lowest of six quarters against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value} two years earlier, but the valuation reserve fell {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.3.value} while raw materials rose {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.0.value} and work in process {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.1.value}, finished goods fell {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.2.value}, and the reserve ratio of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio.value} is below the prior quarter's {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio.value}; with two semiconductor sites closing, the unexplained reserve decline is the point to watch. Purchase commitments in excess of need: no purchase-obligation concept is tagged in any period and no item mentions commitments, so nothing is found and nothing can be tested. Customer concentration: the largest customer, the distributor Arrow Electronics, took {concentration.facts.8.value|pct} of fiscal 2025 sales against {concentration.facts.5.value|pct} in fiscal 2024 and {concentration.facts.2.value|pct} in fiscal 2023, below a tenth; geographic concentration is higher, with China at {concentration.facts.7.value|pct} of fiscal 2025 sales and quarterly China revenue up {note_tables.tables.notes_189.changes.2.value} to {note_tables.tables.notes_189.facts.4.value}. Channel stuffing: no sign in the receivables measures, which sit at six-quarter lows, nor in deferred revenue, and the release cites record bookings; the only adverse signs are the small declines in customer reserves and in the allowance ratio while distribution sales grow. Circular or vendor-financed deals: the company holds equity stakes in Powersem, EB Tech and ATEC and trades with them; sales to Powersem were {note_tables.tables.notes_213.facts.0.value} in the quarter against purchases of {note_tables.tables.notes_213.facts.6.value}, and purchases from ATEC doubled to {note_tables.tables.notes_213.facts.8.value} from {note_tables.tables.notes_213.facts.11.value}, so the pattern is investee-as-supplier, immaterial in size, and no financing of a customer is found.
industry_lens.verdict: No acute industry red flag: inventory turns are at a six-quarter best and customer concentration is modest; the inventory reserve direction and the rising China share are the items to watch.

summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 재고평가충당금이 {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.3.value} 줄어드는 동안 재고는 {note_tables.tables.notes_60.changes.4.value} 늘었고, 대손충당금 비율 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio.value}도 여섯 분기 중 두 번째로 낮습니다. 유형자산 손상 {note_tables.tables.notes_82.facts.27.value}는 공개되지 않은 가정으로 측정됐고, 바슬러 인수가액 조정은 영업권을 {note_tables.tables.notes_67.facts.15.value} 늘려 향후 상각비를 줄이는 방향입니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 개발비 자본화는 태그되지 않았고 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.value}는 전액 비용 처리된 것으로 보입니다. 대신 '특별' 항목으로 분류된 구조조정 비용이 상반기 {note_tables.tables.notes_82.facts.23.value}로 전년 {note_tables.tables.notes_83.facts.23.value}보다 늘어 반복되고 있으며, 설비투자는 감가상각비 {note_tables.tables.notes_187.facts.14.value}에 못 미칩니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 채권매각이나 공급망금융은 어느 기간에도 태그되지 않았고, 매입채무가 후행 영업현금에 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.cash_flow_statement_change.value}를 보탰지만 매출채권과 재고 증가가 이를 상쇄해 조정하지 않았습니다. 보도자료의 순부채는 재무상태표상 순부채 {ratios.solvency.net_debt.value}와 크게 달라 약정 기준 수치임을 보여주며, 약정 EBITDA 정의 완화는 10-Q에 언급되지 않았습니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 내부통제 취약점이나 재작성은 없었고 연말 잔액은 변동 없이 재공시됐습니다. 다만 같은 기간 이자지급액이 두 값으로 태그되고, 차입 발행비용 발생 시점 문구가 바뀌었으며, '발표된' 사업장 폐쇄에 대한 8-K가 없는 등 공시 품질의 작은 흠이 있습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 분기 매출 {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter.value}와 영업현금흐름 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value}는 보도자료 수치와 일치합니다. 그러나 승용차 제품 매출은 {note_tables.tables.notes_10.facts.27.value}에서 {note_tables.tables.notes_9.facts.27.value}로 늘어 보도자료의 설명과 어긋나고, 산업 부문 영업이익은 {note_tables.tables.notes_182.changes.20.value} 증가해 감소를 예상한 항목과 반대였습니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory.value}일로 여섯 분기 중 가장 짧아 회전은 개선됐지만, 반도체 사업장 폐쇄 중에 평가충당금이 줄어든 점은 지켜봐야 합니다. 최대 고객 비중은 {concentration.facts.8.value|pct}로 낮은 반면 중국 매출 비중은 {concentration.facts.7.value|pct}로 높아졌고, 특수관계 거래는 규모가 작습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
